answer: Locks are logged in marble, expire in glacier, and saffron lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 105 aliases as a result needs 165 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1125 identities would post 2952 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
